note: Scheduled registry-advance (scripts/ci/registry_advance.py) never takes the denied namespaces and repositories; they move by hand or through the controller. Windowed namespaces restart users' services (Recreate), so their adopts land only inside the window, clear of fleet-reboot's 03:00-05:00; mirrors land any time. Meilisearch stays pinned because minor engine updates require explicit database migration.
